card.name: Words just before a dosing number
card.fires_on: Small linking words like every, per and to, or a decimal point or space, that come right before a number in a dose or interval, such as every 48 hours or per 2 weeks.

modes.label: Interval word
modes.description: The word every or per just before a number of hours or weeks.
modes.example: 10 mg/kg intravenously<< every>> 48 hours or 5 mg

modes.label: Decimal point or gap in tables
modes.description: A decimal point or space inside a dose table, just before the next digit.

modes.label: Range word
modes.description: The word to in a dose range before the upper number.
modes.example: give 25 to 50 mg (1<< to>> 2 mL) intramuscularly

card.writes: It seems to push the model to write a small number next and to avoid large round number words like hundred or thousand.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a dose number, like the every in every 48 hours.
